name: @emsenn/organizing-a-knowledge-vault
description: Organizing a knowledge vault: the @emsenn/organizing downstream specialization that admits mounted content/ filepath trees as corpus memorystores, glues corpus regions as organizations, and projects knowing memory readings into knowledge-vault corpus, topic, health, and mutation carriers.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist/src',{recursive:true,force:true});" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.json && node copy-dist-assets.mjs && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); for (const f of fs.readdirSync('dist/scripts')) if (f.endsWith('.mjs')) fs.chmodSync('dist/scripts/'+f,0o755);"
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build
scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run build
